principles: Fear is protective information, never the player's identity or an enemy.
Hope must be truthful and grounded rather than forced positivity.
All choices are authored, untimed, replay-safe, and require no disclosure.

encounters.title: The Signal Observatory
encounters.purpose: Notice a fear signal and distinguish a warning from a prediction.
encounters.alarm_information: The Observatory detects intensity, repetition, and uncertainty; a loud signal is not proof.
encounters.hope_information: The living chimes reveal one honest possibility that can exist beside uncertainty.
encounters.shared_consequence: The first thought becomes visible to both lenses without being judged or erased.

steps.instruction: Scan the fear signal without accepting it as fact.
Listen for a truthful possibility beside the alarm.
Name the signal's possible effect, including not sure.
Kindle a beacon for one manageable next step.

encounters.title: The Echo Forest
encounters.purpose: Separate a repeated thought from identity and discover a grounded reframe.
encounters.alarm_information: The archive can compare the original signal with echoes that have grown louder through repetition.
encounters.hope_information: Memory leaves respond only to language that is kind, specific, and believable.
encounters.shared_consequence: The echo moves from blocking the path into a shared viewing window.

steps.instruction: Trace which words came from the original signal.
Grow a grounded counterleaf without denying the fear.
Align the signal and echo records side by side.
Open both viewing windows so neither lens is hidden.

encounters.title: The Cross-Seam Relay
encounters.purpose: Practise cause-and-effect cooperation: one lens changes what the other can reach.
encounters.alarm_information: The brass circuit shows where energy is interrupted but cannot bridge living roots.
encounters.hope_information: The roots can carry the signal but cannot identify a safe voltage alone.
encounters.shared_consequence: Technology and nature form the First-Step Bridge; neither side can complete it alone.

steps.instruction: Set a safe signal for the root network.
Grow a conduit toward the calibrated signal.
Route one measured pulse across the seam.
Weave the pulse and roots into a shared bridge.

encounters.title: The Role-Exchange Storm
encounters.purpose: Experience the other lens and use both perspectives when belonging feels uncertain.
encounters.alarm_information: Storm instruments reveal disconnection patterns but their controls are unfamiliar after the exchange.
encounters.hope_information: Shelter-vines reveal possible connection, while preserving the player's identity and boundaries.
encounters.shared_consequence: After exchanging lenses, both travellers stabilize a Connection Bridge through the storm.

steps.instruction: Exchange lenses before entering the storm.
Map one signal of distance without defining the person by it.
Raise one safe place where connection could begin.
Ground the Truth Array so the storm can pass safely.
Bind the Welcome Vine without asking anyone to change who they are.

encounters.title: The Wisdom Constellation
encounters.purpose: Synthesize Alarm and Hope into wisdom: notice, name, and choose.
encounters.alarm_information: The star-map provides position and pattern but cannot decide what meaning the pattern carries.
encounters.hope_information: The living light provides meaning and possibility but needs the map to form a stable constellation.
encounters.shared_consequence: Both lenses become the Star of Wisdom, one treasure for the future Crown of Life.

steps.instruction: Locate the Notice star.
Give the Name star a truthful light.
Align the safe paths around the Choose star.
Illuminate one possible next step.
